title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E10 — No Place Like Home
During a busy Old Home Day, Officer Delmer patrols the ATV trails; Officer McFadden rescues a trapped barred owl and takes it to be rehabilitated; on Mount Liberty, Officer Towne and trainee LaTourneau save an injured hiker.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E08 — Twists and Turns
Officer McDermott finds an abandoned truck, sparking a winding investigation; Officer Holmes and Sgt. Lucas rescue paddlers near a capsized canoe; Holmes responds to a moose accident, while Officer Frye consoles a bereft woman.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E05 — Case Closed
Lt. Mike Eastman investigates a case of stolen lobster traps; a man on a dirt bike flees the scene after being stopped for speeding; Officer Hannett sends an injured pigeon to a local wildlife rehabber.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E03 — Meltdown
On the Bald Mountain Trail, officers help rescue an injured hiker, but the icy trail puts the whole crew at risk; Officer Egan is the first medical responder to a sudden snowmobile crash, and two four-wheelers crash through ice on Webster Lake.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E01 — Hidden in the Water
As temperatures drop to near-freezing, Officers Canfield and Jones use an ROV to search Merrimack River for a missing person; a man is caught illegally releasing coyotes from traps; officers host a meet-and-greet at the headquarters.

title: Cats 101
description:
S02 E03 — Color Point Shorthair; American Curl, Somali, Japanese Bobtail, Birman
Color Point Shorthair; American Curl, Somali, Japanese Bobtail, Birman.

title: Cats 101
description:
S03 E04 — Bambino, Pixie Bob, Australian Mist, Domestic Longhair, Cats Gone Wild
Inside Bambino, Pixie Bob, Australian Mist, Domestic Longhair, Cats Gone Wild, Cheetoh and Napoleon.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E07 — Miracle Puppies
Dr. Blue flies into action when a Rottweiler in labor gets rushed into the hospital with two puppies stuck inside her; the three vets grab the reins and their cowboy hats to ride horseback into town for Houston's biggest rodeo parade.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E06 — Little Dog, Big Problem
Dr. Blue discovers a huge problem for a paralyzed Yorkie; Dr. Ross takes care of a pair of post-scuffle roosters, before joining Dr. Lavigne on a hyena consultation; the Lavigne family hosts a dinner party showcasing Anne's cooking skills.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E08 — Tuskegee Reunion
The doctors visit their alma mater for a class reunion and become professors for a day; a shih tzu is rushed to the clinic after swallowing a large piece of rawhide, while the owner of a pit bull with a deformed leg must consider drastic surgery.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E05 — Emergency Engine Cat
Dr. Ross and vet tech Kyerra race to save a stray cat horrifically mangled by a car engine; the Rosses move into their new home while Dr. Blue treats a 700-pound arthritic pig; Dr. Lavigne hears a rescue Chihuahua's incredible story.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E11 — My Cat Ruined My Wedding
A couple's plan to move in together could be derailed due to the destructive behavior of Pink, the cat; a couple has been pushed to their limit because of the terrorizing ways of their demonic cat, Zoey.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E12 — Max Hates My Family
Due to the demonic behavior of Max, a family's bond is ripping at the seams; Capri's aggressive tendencies are draining her owner's new roommate. Unfortunately, if nothing changes she will be evicted.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E10 — Cat Horror Show
A couple's show cat named Snickers has become tormented by the lifestyle and is aggressive towards the judges; Dexter's constant meowing has put his owner over the edge and is desperate for a resolution.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E21 — Feel the Burn
Dropped into Guyana's scorching savannah, two super fans battle the oppressive heat and relentless insect attacks; scorching temperatures lead to severe dehydration and force a desperate fan to risk illness by drinking unsanitary fluids.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E12 — Swamp Don't Care
All-star survivalists Jake Nodar and Melissa Miller take on a punishing Florida swamp teeming with poisonous snakes and aggressive alligators; when one of the survivalists becomes disoriented, authorities are called in to conduct an all-out search.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E14 — For Better or a Lot Worse
The first "Naked and Afraid" couple faces challenges to themselves and their relationship as they take on the relentless Guyana jungle; they must work together to battle jaguars, anacondas, caiman, and more than two-million species of insects.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E02 — Frozen and Afraid
Dropped onto a frozen Alaskan glacier, all-star survivalists Laura Zerra and Steven Hall scramble to stave off frostbite and hypothermia; 7,000 miles south, two new survivalists take on a sun-scorched Brazil island, with anaconda and deadly stingray.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E18 — Honduran Hell
In the mountainous rainforest of Honduras, a survivalist with an unusual past is paired with a hard-headed police detective to try and survive 21 days, but predatory jaguars, swarms of fire ants and a debilitating injury threaten their challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E06 — The Beauty and the Bro
A bro bachelor and a divorcée attempt to survive a 14-day fan challenge plagued by unrelenting heat, venomous centipedes and swarms of bees on a remote island in the Philippines; their biggest battle will be with each other.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E05 — Runaway Bride
A survivalist postpones her wedding to try to make it to 21 days with a British commando in the mosquito-infested Colombian tropics.

American Curl kittens prepare for life on the catwalk, a set of Tonkinese run circles around mum, and a Maine Coon tries to show who's boss.

title: Dogs 101
description:
S02 E05 — Border Collie, Chinese Crested, English Mastiff, Italian Greyhound, Lhasa Apso
Facts and trivia about border collies, Chinese cresteds, English mastiffs, Italian greyhounds and Lhasa Apsos.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S01 E02 — Wicked Bite
Jim Lane picks blueberries alone in the Blue Ridge Mountains until a timber rattlesnake attacks; teacher Rachael Lilienthal's swim in a Florida river becomes a struggle when an alligator bites down on her arm, pulls her underwater and doesn't let go.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S01 E04 — Silent Scream
A polar bear chases down Erin Greene as she walks home from a Halloween party in a small arctic town; a bull shark attacks triathlete Chuck Anderson in the Gulf of Mexico, biting his arm and pulling him to the ocean floor.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S01 E03 — Blood in the Water
A grizzly bear charges taxidermist Wilf Lloyd while he hunts elk with his son-in-law in the Canadian Rocky Mountains; miles from shore, diving 180 feet below the surface, spearfisher Anthony Segrich finds a bull shark charging toward him.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E04 — Rattlesnake in My Car
A rattlesnake takes a dip in a pool, while another hides out in a woman's car; Capt. Seifert encounters a blood python.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E06 — Monsters in the Backyard
A 13-foot python takes a dip in a neighborhood pool on Christmas morning.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E01 — Florida's Born Killers
Southern Florida is filled with dangerous examples of native wildlife, including rattlesnakes, cottonmouths and alligators.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E05 — Deer-Eating Python
A monstrous Burmese python poses a threat to the children of a day care center; the team extracts venom from a king cobra to be used as antidote.

title: River Monsters
description:
S06 E06 — Body Snatcher
The rivers of Guyana may host a real freshwater mermaid that the locals call the Water Mama.

Wade comes face-to-face with one of South America's greatest freshwater fighting fish.

description:
Amazon Apocalypse
Wade is on the hunt to find out what was behind the Sobral Santos attack on the Amazon River, where more than 200 passengers were killed on a pitch-black night.

title: River Monsters
description:
S06 E04 — Man-Eating Monster
Wade hunts for the Lau-lau, a creature said to swallow men whole.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E04 — Alaska's Cold Water Killer
A recent fatal incident in the Alaskan wilderness sends Jeremy on a quest for possible suspects that culminates in a showdown with an unexpected, bizarre water beast.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E05 — South Pacific Terrors
Jeremy Wade fights through tropical storms and dangerous jungles to search for a Fijian killer that has been part of the local folklore for years, but there may be more than one.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E01 — Canadian Horror
Jeremy Wade investigates rumors of a twenty-foot lake monster that attacks people; with snakes, freshwater sharks and giant sturgeon unlikely possibilities, the answer as to what it is drives Jeremy crazy.

description:

Wade teams up with a local tribe to solve three mysterious deaths in three different South American countries.

Fun facts and trivia about Australian Shepherds, Xoloitzcuintlis, Korthals Griffons, Pekingese and Chesapeake Bay Retriever.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E02 — Seal the Deal
Two African penguins, Freya and Neo, welcome a young chick, but there's cause for concern when health problems arise; staff work to train a trio of harbor seals to ride the elevator, with the only hiccup being a nervous seal named Floyd.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E03 — Ready for the Jelly
A sweet beluga whale trains with staff to go on the whale scale; a Blacktip reef shark L2 is not eating normally and staff work to figure out why; the first sea lion born at the aquarium is a 1-year-old pup named Scarlett.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E04 — Otter Tale
Beloved Asian small-clawed otter Pinkie has a recurring bloody nose, the team goes to great lengths to find out what could be causing it; feisty baby American alligators arrive at the aquarium and must learn to eat in an orderly way.

title: Tanked
description:
S11 E07 — Going for the Gold(fish)
Wayde and Brett get into the patriotic spirit when Olympic basketball phenom Paul George gives them a call. He wants two identical fish tanks next to his indoor pond, and he wants it done by the time he gets home from the Olympics in Rio.

title: Tanked
description:
S11 E01 — Fish Flop Hip Hop
Hip-hop superstar Akon has purchased a new dream house; Wayde and Brett must build two centerpiece tanks before Akon can move in.

title: Tanked
description:
S11 E05 — Country Superstar Surprise!
Brittany Kerr, wife of country superstar Jason Aldean, wants Wayde and Brett to surprise her husband with a fish tank; the great outdoors-themed tank has to be a total secret and built before Jason returns from his tour.

title: Tanked
description:
S11 E03 — Real Aquariums of Beverly Hills
Star of "The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills" Erika Girardi AKA Erika Jayne wants a tank... and an octopus for that tank.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S08 E04 — Glasshouse Treehouse
Pete treks to New York's Catskill Mountains to build his first glass house in the sky; piecing materials together like a puzzle, Pete uses his clients' collection of 50 vintage windows to construct an elegant tree house encased by walls of glass.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E05 — Thrill 'n' Chill Treehouse
Pete descends upon western Washington to make a tree house for action and relaxation; with a 55-foot-long bouncy-bridge entryway into a 20-foot-high structure and a zip line that travels through the forest, this tree house generates non-stop thrills.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E08 — City Sleeker Treehouse
Pete is back in Texas to build a sophisticated, sleek-and-chic treehouse in the heart of Dallas; Daryl and the NTS team put treehouse engineering to the ultimate test at Washington State University, proving down-to-the-pound the power of the TAB.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E06 — Jeffersonian Honeymoon Suite
Pete and his team descend upon Virginia for the first time to bring the tree house revolution to Bella Rose Plantation; drawing on the architectural innovations of Thomas Jefferson, Pete designs a luxurious two-story tree house with colonial columns.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E02 — Hill Country Hideout
Pete and his gang ride out to the Lone Star State to build a double-decker hideout in Texas Hill Country; Pete creates rustic perfection in six live oak trees with a saloon-style first floor for sippin' sarsaparilla and a glass floor for views below.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E01 — A Treehouse Fit for a Viking
Pete takes on his first international tree house in Norway; working alongside a local builder named Frode, the one-of-a-kind, 24-foot-high retreat accommodates eight and allows for stunning views of the nearby lake.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E07 — The Bird Barn Treehouse
Two retirees get a retreat on their 100-acre Wisconsin farm; Pete builds a barnlike birdhouse with three separate pods -- an art studio, an office and a lounge -- complete with a screened-in porch and a deck overlooking their stable of alpacas.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E10 — Alaskan Mountain Treehouse
Pete travels to Alaska to build a mountaineering lodge in the shadow of North America's highest peak; constructing an A-Framed masterpiece for the Mt. McKinley Princess Wilderness Lodge with breathtaking views of Denali.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S09 E09 — Grace VanderWaal's Got Treehouse
When asked in 2016 what she would do with her winnings, "America's Got Talent" Season 11 winner Grace VanderWaal said she wanted a tree house built by Pete Nelson; the 13-year-old singer-songwriter's wish comes true.

description:
S04 E01 — Gator Girl Smackdown
The boys must catch several large alligators and teach the Mississippi crew wrestling moves before they can return home to Florida; Paul has a dangerous underwater encounter.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S04 E02 — Jimmy Do-Riffle
The boys battle a multitude of nuisance gators; Ashley suspects her job is in jeopardy; Paul tries to teach Kayla how to catch alligators by hand.

title: Hard Truths of Conservation
description:
S04 E10 — Secrets of Africa
In Namibia, Dan Cabela visits conservationist Robin Hurt to see how private land ownership and hunting have restored the landscape to a thriving wildlife area.

title: Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved
description:
S01 E18 — Rattleless Rattlesnake
A look at where to go to find an enchanted underwater forest; some Mexican rattlesnakes have lost their rattle; an Indian elephant.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E05 — Slow Loris Romance
The slow loris has a tiny window for breeding, so staff anxiously help a potential pair connect; the veterinary team develop ground-breaking techniques to treat the stoic pigeons; an okapi with a limp gets a helping hand.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E04 — An Elephant's Trust
Trust and experience are put to the test when an elephant requires delicate veterinary treatment from her keepers; endangered pink pigeons need all the help they can get to produce offspring; Monty the adorable otter needs to visit the dentist.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E08 — Training Dragons
The squirrel monkeys play hard-to-get with the Children's Zoo's keepers; a pair of Komodo dragons meet for the first time, with explosive results; the Inca terns prepare for their first big flight.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E07 — The Eagle Has Landed
A pregnant African wild dog has the staff anxiously preparing for the big day; zoo director Jim Breheny steps in to help a keeper learn how to handle a golden eagle; a new tree in Jungle World gives the gibbons a fresh world to explore.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E02 — The Tiger's Dance
When keepers introduce two tigers as potential mates, the process proves bumpy; a pair of African porcupines arrive at the zoo, requiring delicate handling; a pregnancy check on a 3,000-pound rhino necessitates some highly specialized equipment.
